At the start of the battle, Agent gains <c1>{bog}</c>. For <c2>each</c> allied Doll with <c1>{bog}</c> or allied Hydro Doll without <c1>{bog}</c>, Agent's damage dealt is increased by <c2>16%</c>, to a maximum increase of <c2>80%</c>. If the target is not <c2>within 8 tiles</c> of a <c1>{bqe}</c>, then the <c1>{bqe}</c> will not perform a <c1>{bj}</c>. This effect can trigger up to <c2>1 time</c> per round.

After using the active skill <c1>Tactical Routebook</c> and at the end of her action, Koleda performs <c2>1 instance</c> of <c1>{bm0}</c>. 
When <c1>{blp}</c> performs the active skill <c1>Let's Go for a Spin!</c>, Koleda gains <c1>{blp}</c>'s base attack and critical damage. This effect is removed when <c1>{blp}</c> dies.
